# telnyx_10dlc_phone_number_assignment_task_phone_numbers (Data Source)

The status of each phone number in a task that assigns a messaging profile's numbers to a 10DLC campaign.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `task_id` (String) The task id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `phone_number_assignment_task_phone_numbers` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--phone_number_assignment_task_phone_numbers))

<a id="nestedatt--phone_number_assignment_task_phone_numbers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `phone_number_assignment_task_phone_numbers`

Read-Only:

- `phone_number` (String) The phone number that the status is being checked for.
- `status` (String) The status of the associated phone number assignment.
- `task_id` (String) The ID of the task associated with the phone number.
